source: brice-bourdon (note 92 ; mur d'enduit et meneau, drap plié, horizon), oppenheimer (note 89 ; fauteuil vide, encre dans l'eau, porte entrouverte, verre d'eau, sections notées 4-5) ; règle de la skill sur le secret professionnel.
style: Editorial health photography, calm minimal composition, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, clean lines, generous negative space, subtle film grain, realistic, high detail.
interdits: No patient, no medical procedure, no readable file or screen, no syringe, no blood, no anatomy chart, no stairs, no heights, no enclosed space, nothing frightening.
evite: Évite la scène de soin inventée et ce qui peut inquiéter (oppenheimer exclut escaliers, hauteurs, espaces clos) : lumière, matières du cabinet et images de calme.

404.consigne: Calm horizon line over perfectly still water at dawn, light mist, the horizon very slightly tilted to suggest a loss of balance, no people, no boats, no buildings.
404.evite: La chute ou le malaise montrés.

ouverture.consigne: Very subtle {matieres} lit by soft daylight from the upper left, a faint diffuse shadow of a vertical window mullion falling straight down the right half of the frame like a plumb line, extremely minimal, no objects, no people.

section-fond.consigne: A quiet living-room corner at dawn: an empty upholstered armchair beside a tall window with sheer linen curtains, a small side table with a short stack of books whose spines are completely blank.
section-fond.evite: Le divan de cabinet et la consultation.

scene-metier.consigne: Macro close-up of {sujet}, low raking light drawing long soft folds and deep shadows, almost monochrome, tactile, no people.
scene-metier.evite: Le geste de soin sur un corps.

lieu.consigne: A door left half open onto a bright, calm hallway flooded with soft daylight, seen from a dimmer room, inviting rather than frightening, simple and serene.

texture.consigne: Macro photograph of a single drop of ink blooming in perfectly clear water, delicate swirling tendrils and soft cloud shapes, light background, plenty of empty space around it.
texture.evite: Le motif qui évoque un test projectif ou une image médicale.

portrait-generique.consigne: Side profile silhouette of a person standing near a tall bright window, softly backlit, the face turned away and in shadow so they cannot be identified, light linen clothing, plain plaster wall, serene and respectful mood.
